interval_method: 95% paired-match-seed block bootstrap, 2000 resamples; hand ratios resample counts

style_definitions.open: hands with an open meld / hands
style_definitions.safe_choice: genbutsu against every riichi opponent, conditional on having a safe legal discard and not already being in riichi
style_definitions.shanten_backoff: chosen genbutsu worsens shanten versus best legal discard under the same condition, with at least two discard kinds; behavioral proxy, not inferred intent

experiment.opponents: each opponent seat: 50% greedy, 50% frozen historical self-play; selected for a whole match
experiment.comparison: V1 published baseline plus a V1 control with matched new training; V2 BC and two independent V2 RL seeds. Test walls never select a checkpoint.
experiment.release_gate: Independent test upper 95% CI of rank difference vs greedy and vs BC must both be below zero. A failed gate retains experimental artifacts without replacing the game model.
experiment.coldstart_selection: Fidelity gates first, then overall teacher-set accuracy, then overall held-out teacher-set loss; rare-action losses are reported separately.

teacher.note: Immutable public feature tensors reused with original producer provenance; no source hash is relabeled.

validation.note: Immutable public feature tensors reused with original producer provenance; no source hash is relabeled.
